## dividing_codons

dividing_codons function takes RNA sequence (string), counts where the codon should start and divides the sequence into reading codes.

```{r}
dividing_codons("AAUUGGCC")
#>[1] "AAU" "UGG"
```

## Func 4

## count_plot

The function takes in the sequence of amino acids as a parameter and counts the appearance of each amino acid.

It is done by defining the unique amino acids from the sequence into a new variable and then counting the number of times they appear in the sequence. The data frame is created storing those counts.

The results are returned in a form of a barplot visualizing the amino acids counts.

Example:

```{r}
count_plot('AKLMAKKK')
```
